explanation: For each possible word alignment, slide a window in whole-word steps. Track word multiplicities; reset at unknown words and shrink when a word is overrepresented. Record windows containing exactly the supplied multiset, then sort their starting indices.
timeComplexity: O(nw + mw + r log r) expected time, for text length n, word length w, m words and r matches; substring hashing/copying costs O(w).
spaceComplexity: O(mw + r) stored character/output space, plus transient word substrings.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
